notes.title: BATTLECLAWS AT DUBLIN COMIC CON 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895399/f19cc3d61fa6d3154adc61c38e6b231aea5fc7d4.png"][/img][/p][h1]BATTLECLAWS AT DUBLIN COMIC CON 2025[/h1][p][/p][p]We know it's been some time since we posted an update on BattleClaws, but we've been working hard on a BIG update that you'll be able to play at Dublin Comic Con this summer, August 9th and 10th!
[/p][p]You can expect to see some exciting new gameplay features, a visual glow up, and another massive surprise which we're keeping a secret for now!

For our Early Access supporters, we'll be updating the build here on steam in line with the event. For now, You'll still need to plug in controllers or use Steam's Remote Play to play on PC (We know, we're sorry).

We'll be giving out freebies and steam keys during the event, so come say hi, challenge the Devs to a free rounds and nab yourself a free copy of the game while you're there! 
[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who has supported this project so far, 
We're delighted to be coming back at Comic Con and we hope to see you there! [/p][p]Lauren [/p][p]BattleClaws Dev

[/p]

notes.title: BattleClaws "Clawsmetics" have arrived!
notes.content:
This is a small update that packs a mighty punch in the form of customization options, bug fixes and quality of life improvements!
This patch includes the following changes:

- Introducing the first batch of Clawsmetics (and there's more where that came from!)
options include:
Cowboy hat
Flower
Party hat
Cow bell
Pig tails
Moustache
Googly eyes
Toilet
Plunger
Prop hat


Quality of Life Improvements:

- Quitting the game from the pause menu now presents additional options Main Menu / Close App
- Players have the option to begin an instant rematch at the end of the current game with all the same settings
- Visual clarity improvements to the Player Select and GamePlay UI / Signposting

Big Fixes:
- Minor clipping issues on the Player Select and Gameplay arenas
- Collectables occasionally getting caught on the borders of the arena
- Collisions sometimes knocking players out of bounds

notes.title: BattleClaws is headed to Dublin Comic Con (again!)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm very excited to announce that BattleClaws is returning to Dublin Comic Con for the Summer Edition happening in August! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895399/23f9243dbef802d7a65b0882cf4c4ff47520a277.png[/img]

We'll be bringing the latest version of the game with us, and we'll have tons of stickers, and even a few steam keys to give away, so don't be afraid to stop by and play a few rounds against your friends. 



BattleClaws will be released into Early Access in just a few days, and we have new features and major content updates still to come. The game may look verrrry different by the time you see us at Comic Con!

As always, thank you for your support!
Lauren
BattleClaws dev

notes.title: We're Preparing For Early Access!
notes.content:
Good News, Everyone!

BattleClaws will release into Early Access on July 31st, and we couldn't be more excited! 

You can check out the teaser trailer on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835960/BattleClaws/]store page[/url] for a sneak peek at the latest updates. 

It feels surreal to be so close to our initial release and as a team we're insanely grateful for your support up to this point. Seeing your engagement with our humble demo at the events we've attended and watching you getting competitive over those final scores has been a highlight for sure!
Your insights and feedback are going to be instrumental in shaping the future of this project, and we've got a ton of new features and updates planned. 

We'll be making big announcements here very very soon, so watch this space!
Lauren
BattleClaws Dev

notes.title: BattleClaws at the Irish Gaming Market 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're delighted to announce that the BattleClaws development team will be attending the Irish Gaming Market, taking place July 13th and 14th! 

You can find us in the Indie Zone where you'll be able to chat to our game devs, play a few rounds of the BattleClaws demo and pick up some goodies.
We're also going to be making an appearance on the IGM mainstage each day from 12.00 - 12.30pm  where we will be hosting live BattleClaws tournaments and giving away a free copy of BattleClaws to the victors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895399/922d95fa73868a947d8cf84c8b520df96c44c153.png[/img]

Thanks for your continued support and we'll see you at the Irish Gaming Market!

Lauren
BattleClaws Dev

notes.title: BATTLECLAWS IS COMING TO GAMERFEST DUBLIN 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
So many of you have added BattleClaws to your steam wishlist and we are so dedicated to bringing you the best experience possible! 

Before that though...we are coming to GamerFest Dublin next week with the BattleClaws demo!
[url=https://gamerfest.ie/]GamerFest[/url] is Ireland’s biggest gaming and esports festival, taking place in the RDS, Dublin. May 25th and May 26th, 2024. 

There'll be tons of games available to play, and we'll be in the Indie Dev space both days! Feel free to come and say hello, play a few rounds of BattleClaws with your friends and maybe nab a couple of stickers! 

You can get tickets now at GamerFest.ie!

As always, thank you for your continued support and for following along as we get closer to our official release. It's awesome to see so many of you enjoying the game and looking forward to the full version. 

Lauren
BattleClaws Dev

notes.title: BattleClaws at Dublin Comic Con 2024 Spring Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895399/5dbc13d492644663a77cca4bd9660a17dfb43b03.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

This weekend has been so exciting and firstly we want to say a massive thank you! to everyone who stopped to say hello and play the latest BattleClaws demo at Dublin Comic Con. 
BattleClaws had upwards of 600 players across Saturday and Sunday and we are delighted we got to meet you all! 

I wanted to take the opportunity to answer some burning questions we received over the weekend:
 1. What platforms will BattleClaws be released on?
     BattleClaws will be released on steam for PC with controller support. We are considering additional 
     platforms for future releases, but more on that later!

2.  Will there be other game modes?
     Yes! We brought Battle Mode to Comic Con, a mode where 2-4 players battle it out until the last claw 
      standing is declared the winner, but we intend for a single player mode, and even some co-operative 
      play to feature in future releases. 

  
We're feeling super excited about sharing the full version of BattleClaws with you all soon, and if you'd like to ask us a question, or keep up to date with events, announcements and development progress, please wishlist the game on steam, or visit our [url=https://linktr.ee/battleclaws]website![/url] 

Thank you for your continued support,
Lauren
(BattleClaws Dev)
